OPERATION_MODE_DESCRIPTION: Only one mode can stay active. When mode changes, routes, screens, and exclusive features of the other mode are disabled. No channel, customer, stream, or configuration data is deleted.
OPERATION_MODE_CONFIRMATION: Confirm operation mode change? This takes effect immediately and disables exclusive features from the previous mode.
SHOWROOM_MODE_MESSAGE: The system is in showroom mode. Data is automatically reset every 12 hours.
